name: Merrytime Mexican Riviera Crispy Chicken/Beef Taquitos & Cinnamon Buñuelos
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Merrytime Mexican Riviera Cruise Specials
whyItWorks: Festive Merrytime Baja/Mexican Riviera specialties; shredded chicken and flour buñuelos are low-fiber but deep-fried in oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for soft warm flour or corn tortillas with plain shredded chicken instead of fried taquitos if flaring, and skip spicy salsa/crema.
watchOuts: Deep-fried tortillas and fried pastry oil
